evidence.says: Script Extender's table of byte patterns names this function: the pattern of its mapping esv::GameStateMachine::Update is found once in the binary and an instruction it marks refers here
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; a stored pair of the two builds joins that function to this one (a seed)
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database matches the export to this function by strings

questions.ask: What the function does: it is named from Script Extender's table and has not been read
